name: What is only here
what: Silo lists what is only here on a computer: what nothing would bring back if it vanished, neither a pull nor a rebuild, and anything it cannot place. A package installed by hand and absent from the computer's recipe is on that list, and Silo offers to add it to the recipe.

suggest.why: What a drop or a fork becoming main shows you first is this list, and it turns a whole machine into the few things worth saving.
